module: Viscous coupler placed behind an engine: transmits a torque proportional to the angular speed difference between input and output (viscousCoef, in N·m per rad/s), capped at viscousTorque. Can be progressively "engaged" above an RPM cutInRPM (cutInRPM, stallRPM). Serves as a simple automatic clutch (e.g. small vehicles, gearboxes without a driven clutch). Categories clutchlike and viscouscoupling; one output port.
notes: jbeam keys: viscousCoef (10 N·m per rad/s), viscousTorque (max N·m; otherwise engine maxTorque*1.25 + maxRPM*inertia*pi/30), viscousSmoothing (25, exponential torque smoothing), cutInRPM (RPM, optional), stallRPM (0.1 RPM by default), additionalEngineInertia (0), breakTriggerBeam ('' = cancel), inputName, inputIndex.

When cutInRPM is defined, the internal clutch coefficient is clamp((inputAV - cutInAV) / stallAV, 0, 1): engaged between cutInRPM and cutInRPM + stallRPM; with the default stallRPM = 0.1 the transition is almost instantaneous.
device.clutchRatio (1 by default) can be modified from outside to disengage; the final torque = clamp(viscousCoef*(inputAV-outputAV1), ±viscousTorque) * min(clutchRatio, internal ratio), smoothed.
rpm -> rad/s conversion: factor 0.104719755. Units: AV in rad/s, torques in N·m.
Anomaly: reset() rereads viscousCoef from jbeamData (default 10), so a dynamically modified viscousCoef is restored on reset; it is not reread for viscousTorque.

new.desc: Builds the viscous coupler from the jbeam.

device.desc: Object returned by new(jbeamData). Fields: inputAV, outputAV1 (rad/s), outputTorque1 and torqueDiff (N·m), clutchRatio (0..1), viscousCoef, viscousTorque, cutInAV, stallAV (rad/s), isBroken, mode.

velocityUpdate.desc: Physics step: inputAV = output speed of the parent (engine).

torqueUpdate.desc: Physics step: computes the viscous torque (speed difference), applies clutchRatio and the engagement at cutInRPM, smooths and places the result in torqueDiff and outputTorque1.

setMode.desc: Stores the mode and reinstalls velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate (the mode has no other effect here).

validate.desc: Checks that the parent is an engine and sets the default viscousTorque.

returns.desc: false if the parent is not an engine.

calculateInertia.desc: Takes the cumulative inertia and ratios of the first child (the coupler adds no inertia).

reset.desc: Resets speeds, torque, clutchRatio=1, rereads viscousCoef and reinitializes the smoother.
